name: berth-plugin-unity
description: Unity CLI and editor for berth machines.

features.label: Unity CLI
features.description: Install the Unity CLI and the libraries the Unity editor needs. Adds the Unity sign-in to the overview, and its state to Status, Self-Test and Update.
features.summary: Unity CLI (`unity`) with its agent skills.

actions.name: account
actions.label: Unity sign-in and license
actions.help: Whether the Unity CLI is signed in on the host and which license is active. Part of "Show who is signed in".
actions.run: export UNITY_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 UNITY_NO_BANNER=1 UNITY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1; echo "── Unity"; unity auth status; unity license status; echo

actions.name: status
actions.label: Unity CLI and editors
actions.help: The version of the Unity CLI and the editors that are installed. Part of Status and of the Self-Test.
actions.run: export UNITY_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 UNITY_NO_BANNER=1 UNITY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1; echo; echo "── Unity"; unity --version && unity editors --installed

actions.name: update
actions.label: Update the Unity CLI
actions.help: Bring the Unity CLI to its latest version. Part of Update.
actions.run: export UNITY_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 UNITY_NO_BANNER=1 UNITY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1; echo; echo "── Unity CLI"; unity self-update --yes

actions.name: login
actions.label: Sign in to Unity
actions.help: Runs unity auth login on the host as the agent and shows its link here. Open the link in your own browser and sign in; the host notices by itself. The license is activated afterwards, falling back to Unity Personal and accepting its terms.
actions.run: export UNITY_NO_BANNER=1 UNITY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1; env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY BROWSER=echo unity auth login || exit 1; export UNITY_NON_INTERACTIVE=1; unity license activate; unity license status >/dev/null 2>&1 || unity license activate --personal --accept-eula; unity license status

actions.name: license
actions.label: Activate the Unity license
actions.help: Activate the license of the signed-in account, falling back to Unity Personal and accepting its terms. Needs the sign-in to have been done once.
actions.run: export UNITY_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 UNITY_NO_BANNER=1 UNITY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1; unity license activate; unity license status >/dev/null 2>&1 || unity license activate --personal --accept-eula; unity license status

features.label: Unity Editor
features.description: Install a Unity editor with the CLI, several gigabytes. Needs the Unity CLI. The version is `devbox_unity_editor_version` in the profile's ansible_vars (default 6000.7.0b8), its modules `devbox_unity_editor_modules` (default webgl).
features.summary: A Unity editor is preinstalled in `~/Unity/Hub/Editor/`; `unity editors --installed` lists it.
